Which arguments of cvm_fetch() a table takes

Source: R/discovery.R
cvm_arguments.Rd

cvm_fetch() serves every table with one signature, but not every argument applies to every table: basis is required for the statements published both individual and consolidated and refused everywhere else, as_of only applies to a registry, year not to a single snapshot. cvm_arguments() says, for one table, which of these arguments are required, which are optional and which are not allowed, with the values each one takes.

Usage

cvm_arguments(dataset, table, group = NULL)

Arguments

dataset

Short dataset id (e.g. "dfp").

table

Table name within the dataset (e.g. "bpa").

group

Optional CKAN group slug (e.g. "companhias"). When NULL (default) the function resolves by uniqueness across the embedded snapshot. From v0.4 onward, datasets may exist in more than one group; in that case omitting group aborts with cvmdata_error_input_ambiguous.

Value

A tibble with one row per argument of cvm_fetch() that selects rows (dataset and table are always required and not listed):

  • argument: the argument name.

  • status: "required", "optional" or "not allowed".

  • values: the values it takes for this table, or NA when it is not allowed. For year, the years the table is published as the package knows them; the latest year is found when reading.

Details

The answer is read from the same table schemas that cvm_fetch() checks its arguments against, so the two never disagree: an argument marked "not allowed" aborts cvm_fetch() with cvmdata_error_input, and a "required" one left out does too. The function reads only the installed schemas and needs no internet.

See also

cvm_fetch(), section "Arguments by table", for the same rules across every table.

Other discovery: cvm_codelist(), cvm_dataset_years(), cvm_datasets(), cvm_dictionary(), cvm_groups(), cvm_tables()

Examples

# A statement: `basis` is required
cvm_arguments("dfp", "bpa")
#> # A tibble: 10 × 3
#>    argument status      values                                                  
#>    <chr>    <chr>       <chr>                                                   
#>  1 cnpj     optional    "CNPJ, with or without punctuation"                     
#>  2 ticker   optional    "B3 ticker, e.g. \"PETR4\""                             
#>  3 year     optional    "2010 onwards; NULL = latest year"                      
#>  4 from     optional    "full date (\"YYYY-MM-DD\"); `from` and `to` together, …
#>  5 to       optional    "full date (\"YYYY-MM-DD\"); `from` and `to` together, …
#>  6 as_of    not allowed  NA                                                     
#>  7 basis    required    "\"ind\", \"con\" or both"                              
#>  8 reading  optional    "\"original\", \"restated\" or both"                    
#>  9 source   optional    "\"mirror\", \"cvm\"; NULL = session default"           
#> 10 on_error optional    "\"abort\", \"warn\""                                   

# The registry: no `year`, but `as_of`
cvm_arguments("cad", "companhias")
#> # A tibble: 10 × 3
#>    argument status      values                                       
#>    <chr>    <chr>       <chr>                                        
#>  1 cnpj     optional    "CNPJ, with or without punctuation"          
#>  2 ticker   optional    "B3 ticker, e.g. \"PETR4\""                  
#>  3 year     not allowed  NA                                          
#>  4 from     not allowed  NA                                          
#>  5 to       not allowed  NA                                          
#>  6 as_of    optional    "full date (\"YYYY-MM-DD\")"                 
#>  7 basis    not allowed  NA                                          
#>  8 reading  not allowed  NA                                          
#>  9 source   optional    "\"mirror\", \"cvm\"; NULL = session default"
#> 10 on_error optional    "\"abort\", \"warn\""                        

# Only the required ones
args <- cvm_arguments("dfp", "dre")
args[args$status == "required", ]
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   argument status   values                    
#>   <chr>    <chr>    <chr>                     
#> 1 basis    required "\"ind\", \"con\" or both"
